I am amazed by just how wel Nooro works on my knee pain. Like pain is gone! Want to make a good product even better? Put raised dots on each of the control buttons, for example, 1 dot on the on/inc button, 2 dots on the off/dec button, 3 dots on program button button. Having some way to tell which button is which, it would be much easier to use on your back or neck or wherever you need to see in order to use the right control.
